description: Design site-directed mutagenesis primers (QuikChange overlapping or Q5 back-to-back) for a base substitution, an amino-acid codon swap, or an insertion/deletion/delins. The edit can be given as fields or, more simply, by NAME in `mutation`: "E52K", "p.Glu52Lys", "c.155A>G", "c.76_78del", "c.76_77insGGA", "c.76_78dup". A named mutation is checked against the template — if the reference allele it states is not what is actually at that position, the call is refused and the real base or residue is quoted back, because a coordinate belonging to a different transcript or the other strand yields perfectly well-formed primers for the wrong base. `interpretedAs` in the response says which reading was designed.

armTmTarget.description: Target Tm (°C) for each template-binding arm.

deleteLength.description: Template bases to remove, starting at `position` (delins edit). 0 with `insert` set is a pure insertion, placed immediately before `position`.

editKind.description: Edit level. Normally omitted — it is inferred from the fields you send (newBase means nt, targetAa means aa, insert/deleteLength means delins).

frameStart.description: 1-based position of the first base of codon 1. Needed whenever the coding sequence does not start at base 1 of the template — a residue number means nothing without it.

insert.description: Bases to put in place of the deleted span (delins edit). Omit for a pure deletion. NOTE the convention when deleteLength is 0: the insert lands immediately BEFORE `position`, so position 101 + insert "GGA" is the same edit as mutation: "c.100_101insGGA" — HGVS names the two flanking bases, this names the base the insert sits in front of. `interpretedAs` states which bases the insert ended up between.

mutation.description: The edit by name — "E52K", "p.Glu52Lys", "Q100*", "c.155A>G", "A155G", "c.76_78del", "c.76_77insGGA", "c.76_78dup", "c.76delinsAA". Replaces the field-by-field forms below. An unprefixed "A123G" is a legal reading at BOTH levels; it is resolved by which one matches the template, and refused if both do.

organism.description: Codon-usage table for choosing the new codon (aa edit). Latin names and common strain/cell-line names are accepted.

position.description: 1-based position to substitute (nt), or the first base of the span to replace (delins). Required for those forms — it is never assumed. For a pure insertion (deleteLength 0) it is the base the insert goes in FRONT of.

targetAa.description: Target amino acid, one-letter code incl '*' (aa edit).

template.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: site_directed_mutagenesis
title: Site-directed mutagenesis designer
